_about: Facts we know must appear in each seed guide. scripts/seed.ts fails the run if one is missing, so a regression is caught by code, not by a reader. Each fact passes when every pattern in 'all' matches somewhere in the guide text (case-insensitive).

github.fact: Organizations can block the app until an owner approves it
No GitHub review before users can connect
Expire user access tokens is on by default
Device flow is a setting to decide on

gmail.fact: Restricted Gmail scopes need Google verification
Restricted scopes need a security assessment (CASA)
Testing mode: authorizations expire after 7 days
gmail.send is sensitive, not restricted, so it avoids the assessment
Workspace admins can block the app
